rationale: The long thesis has weakened: FRVO has slipped below the 5-minute 9-EMA at $11.15 and the latest 1-minute candle broke the tight consolidation on increased volume, leaving the position at its maximum adverse excursion. A short flip is not attractive given the still-strong market backdrop and price well above session VWAP, so closing reduces risk without committing to a countertrend short.
